name: Picamilon
summary: An analogue of GABA that passes the brain blood barrier, which is then hydrolyzed into GABA and niacin. It is suggested GABA is the producer of an anxiolytic effect from this action. In contrast, it is suggested niacin acts as a vasodilator. Picamilon is often used in nootropic 'stacks'.

helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: A Russian study from 1991 showed that picamilon permeated the blood–brain barrier in cats and increased cerebral blood flow. Further work showed it crosses the blood-brain barrier in mice and rats. It is believed that picamilon is hydrolyzed into GABA and niacin, similar to the way tocopheryl nicotinate (vitamin E nicotinate) is hydrolyzed. GABA in the brain would activate GABA receptors, which in theory should have an anxiolytic effect.

uses.text: It was developed in the Soviet Union in 1969 and further studied in both Russia and Japan as a prodrug of GABA. In Russia, picamilon is sold as a prescription drug. It is not approved for sale in the United States and has been deemed an adulterating agent in dietary supplements, with five American companies required to remove their picamilon products from the market in November 2015.

sideEffects.en: The niacin part can cause flushing, warmth and itching of the skin, and it can lower blood pressure, causing dizziness. It is sold as a supplement in some countries and its long-term effects have not been well studied.
sideEffects.zh: 菸鹼酸部分可能造成臉部潮紅、發熱與皮膚搔癢，也可能使血壓下降而引起頭暈。它在某些國家作為補充品販售，長期影響尚無充分研究。
sideEffects.zhHans: 烟碱酸部分可能造成脸部潮红、发热与皮肤搔痒，也可能使血压下降而引起头晕。它在某些国家作为补充品贩售，长期影响尚无充分研究。

fact.en: It is GABA joined to niacin, which is vitamin B3. GABA alone cannot cross into the brain, and the niacin part was added to carry it across.
fact.zh: 它是 GABA 與菸鹼酸（維生素 B3）結合的產物。GABA 本身無法進入大腦，加上菸鹼酸部分正是為了把它帶過去。
fact.zhHans: 它是 GABA 与烟碱酸（维生素 B3）结合的产物。GABA 本身无法进入大脑，加上烟碱酸部分正是为了把它带过去。
